clue.text: Left port with cargo aboard

parts.note: Aden is a port city in Yemen

explanation.surface: A ship sets sail from the harbour fully loaded.
explanation.definitionFit: A vessel carrying a heavy load of goods is said to be loaded or weighed down.

clue.text: Clear to me anyhow that he arrives after the due time

definitions.text: he arrives after the due time

indicators.note: anyhow means in any old way, so the letters of the preceding words are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone shrugs that it is clear to them how a tardy guest shows up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'anyhow' rearranges CLEARTOME into the nine-letter answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who turns up once proceedings have begun is a tardy arrival.

clue.text: Imagined being asleep

parts.note: describes picturing things in the mind during slumber, a past-tense verb for night visions

explanation.definitionFit: Visions experienced in slumber are what one sees at night, so to picture things then is this verb.

clue.text: Tidy stock

definitions.meaning: stock is livestock, and an old word for cattle is this

explanation.definitionFit: Orderly describes something trim; separately, cattle are called by this old term.

clue.text: Young and inexperienced having only just washed?

definitions.meaning: naive and green, lacking worldly knowledge
literally still damp in the spot behind one's head after a wash

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for naivety pictures a newborn still damp from birth; literally someone fresh from a wash is still damp there.

clue.text: Asserting Ron's produced an in, infringement

indicators.note: produced suggests the letters are worked into something new, signalling a rearrangement

explanation.surface: Ron insists on something that turns out to be a breach of the rules.
explanation.walkthrough: 'produced' rearranges ASSERTINGRONS (the possessive S counted here as a letter) into the answer; 'an in,' reads as a printing slip and is passed over as link words.
explanation.definitionFit: A breach of a law or rule is a wrongdoing or violation.

clue.text: Detailed animal shows impetuosity

indicators.note: de-tailed means the tail, the last letter, is cut off the word

parts.note: an eland is a large African antelope

explanation.surface: An elaborately described creature displays rash energy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Detailed' looks like 'described minutely', but it means losing a tail: ELAND loses its final D.
explanation.definitionFit: Dash and flair, a spirited eagerness, is close to rashness and vigour.

clue.text: One's to post one to a Moslem

parts.note: one is I, and one's (one is) gives I'S
to post is to mail
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone means to send a letter to a Muslim.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of a branch of Shia Islam led by the Aga Khan is a Muslim, here in the older spelling.

clue.text: Very many kept cool and gambled

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a crossword shorthand for a great number
iced means chilled or kept cold

explanation.surface: A crowd stayed calm and placed their bets.
explanation.definitionFit: Playing with dice is gambling, so having played with the cubes is to have staked money.

clue.text: See 4
The wretch stumbled in and died totally unclad!

indicators.note: in places the stumbling word inside the word for the wretch

parts.note: a snake is a treacherous, despicable person
tripped means stumbled
D is the abbreviation for died in genealogies

explanation.surface: A villain trips over and dies with no clothes on.
explanation.definitionFit: Wearing no clothes at all, stark and bare.

clue.text: Ian came round looking pale and sickly

indicators.note: round suggests turning the letters about into a new order

explanation.definitionFit: Lacking red blood cells leaves a person wan and weak, so the term means pallid and poorly.

clue.text: Fortified site used by holiday makers

definitions.meaning: a military encampment or fortified position
a place where holidaymakers pitch tents

explanation.definitionFit: An army encampment is a defended base; holidaymakers also stay at a site of tents or huts.

clue.text: Do not start to strain the lock

indicators.note: do not start tells us to drop the first letter of the next word's synonym

parts.note: stress means strain or pressure

explanation.surface: An instruction not to begin tugging at someone's hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A curl or long piece of hair is called a lock.

clue.text: Understanding type

explanation.definitionFit: Considerate people are gentle and sympathetic; separately, a sort or category.

clue.text: Availing oneself of American gin cocktail

indicators.note: a cocktail is a mixture, so the letters of gin are mixed

explanation.surface: Someone helps themselves to a drink made with American gin.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking advantage of something is employing it.

clue.text: Bridge partners are in a trap

parts.note: in bridge, South and North play as partners, giving S and N

explanation.surface: Two card players find themselves caught out.
explanation.walkthrough: In the card game bridge, players sit as North, South, East and West, North partnering South.
explanation.definitionFit: A noose or device for catching animals is a trap.

clue.text: The way of working is not in English

definitions.text: The way of working is not in English

parts.words: The way of working is not in English
parts.note: a method of operating, expressed in a foreign tongue, namely Latin

explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase for a method of operating is used for a habitual way of doing things.

clue.text: Distinguished record by Ernest and Edmund

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
Ern is a short form of the name Ernest
Ed is a short form of the name Edmund

explanation.surface: An eminent recording made by two men called Ernest and Edmund.
explanation.definitionFit: To have made out or perceived something is to have told it apart.

clue.text: What happens during a famine? Protests in jail possibly

definitions.meaning: read literally, starvation hits people when food runs out
refusals to eat as a protest, often by prisoners

explanation.definitionFit: In a famine starvation literally hits; prisoners refusing food as protest stage fasts of that name.

clue.text: Many changing in hotel disheartened on Sunday by songbooks

indicators.note: in puts the rearranged letters within the outer pair of the hotel word
disheartened removes the heart, leaving the first and last letters of hotel
changing signals the letters of many are rearranged

explanation.surface: Many people, dispirited in a hotel on a Sunday, change books of songs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disheartened' leaves HL from hotel; 'changing' turns MANY into YMNA, which goes 'in' HL; S is added after.
explanation.definitionFit: Books of hymns sung in church are collections of songs.

clue.text: The basic idea of a tonic

definitions.meaning: in music the tonic is the first note of the scale

explanation.definitionFit: A central theme sets the tone of a speech; in music the tonic is the note naming the key.

clue.text: Discourage although only slightly wet

explanation.definitionFit: Dampening spirits discourages; a slightly moist thing is a little wet.

clue.text: Untidy study needs spring cleaning?

indicators.note: untidy suggests the letters are left in disorder

explanation.surface: A messy study is in want of a big seasonal clean.
explanation.definitionFit: A room covered in a layer of grime is the kind that wants a thorough seasonal clean.

clue.text: It can become a lark

indicators.note: become signals that the letters change into something else

explanation.surface: A suggestion that something could turn into a bit of fun.
explanation.definitionFit: A prank or caper, playful behaviour, is a bit of fun.

clue.text: Dishonest-sounding musical instrument

indicators.note: sounding tells us the word for dishonest person is said aloud

parts.note: a dishonest person is a liar

explanation.surface: An instrument whose tone sounds insincere.
explanation.definitionFit: A small harp of ancient Greece is a stringed instrument.

clue.text: About four, I in France dance

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the French word wraps the numeral

parts.note: je is French for I
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Around four o'clock, someone in France takes to the dance floor.
explanation.definitionFit: A lively swing dance to jazz music.

clue.text: Stumped by record pace

parts.note: st is the cricket abbreviation for stumped
an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: A cricketer is stumped by a measured stride.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a batsman is 'stumped' when the wicketkeeper breaks the wicket while the batsman is out of the crease.
explanation.definitionFit: A single stride is a pace.

clue.text: Unwell in the main

parts.note: 'in the main' seems to mean mostly, but the main is the open ocean, so ill on the ocean

explanation.definitionFit: Feeling nauseous from a ship's motion on the ocean, which poets call the main.

clue.text: Experienced being at least two days old

definitions.text: being at least two days old
definitions.meaning: literally, someone delivered earlier than one day ago

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means shrewd and not gullible; literally, a person delivered earlier than the previous day.

clue.text: See 27
Make an appeal quietly to take the star part

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical direction for quietly
the lead is the leading role in a show

explanation.surface: An actor quietly asks to play the main role.
explanation.definitionFit: To beg or petition earnestly, as in court.
